extension.description: See changes. Know history. A local Git workspace for VS Code.
setting.inlineBlame.enabled: Show line authors, commit messages, and commit detail links in the editor.
setting.inlineBlame.mode: Annotate the current line by default; allLines annotates the whole file.
setting.inlineBlame.mode.allLines: Annotate all lines in the file.
setting.inlineBlame.maxLines: Maximum number of lines to decorate when inline blame is enabled.
setting.sshProxy: SOCKS5 proxy for SSH GitHub connections, such as 127.0.0.1:7890. Leave empty to use the system SSH configuration.
setting.codeLens.enabled: Show code attribution and history links above functions and classes. Uses current retained lines; unsaved documents are skipped.
setting.codeLens.maxLines: Maximum file length for CodeLens attribution.
setting.codeLens.maxSymbols: Maximum number of function and class locations annotated in each file.
